about.title: About
about.p1: Since 2019, I have built software for insurance, finance and e-commerce. My work spans product decisions, service integrations, interfaces and the upkeep of production systems.
about.p2: At Wingie Enuygun Group, I build the insurance comparison and purchase flows customers use every day. I also co-founded Monafy, where we bring financial data, market reports and an AI assistant together for Turkish and US stock markets.

lines: final readonly class TimurhanKaya extends Developer implements ArchitectInterface

about.p3: I built Monafy with AI agents, without writing the code by hand. I design the product and architecture, give agents the context they need and verify their work. Prompt and context engineering are part of that process, alongside integrations that connect model responses to product data.

items.name: Vampir Köylü
items.description: A multiplayer browser game built around night and day phases, different roles, and shared decisions.
highlights: I wanted friends to join one room and play with hidden roles. What players can do and see changes as the game progresses.

The lobby and role assignment lead to night actions, day voting, and result tracking. Roles such as doctor, detective, and hunter introduce different rules. Each phase needs a consistent transition to the next.

I separated role assignment, night resolution, and win conditions into focused responsibilities. Public player state stays separate from hidden role information. This keeps the interface simple and makes individual rules easier to verify.
